releaseNotes:
- Per-Profile Seerr Isolation: Scoped Seerr server URLs, the Media Requests toggle, Seerr session cookies, and the last-selected server preference strictly per Plix profile so newly created profiles no longer inherit another profile's Requests configuration.
- Requests Grid D-Pad Navigation Fix: Added explicit Left/Right focus-node navigation to Seerr poster cards across category "See More" pages, search results, and overview rows so pressing Left/Right in long scrolled grids stays on the same row instead of jumping up a row.
- App Version Bump: v1.11.3 (versionCode 62)
